fields.description: Zithrin 500mg provides high intracellular penetration and prolonged tissue half-life, allowing convenient once-daily 3-day therapy for tonsillitis, pharyngitis, community-acquired pneumonia, and urethritis.

fields.name: Moxaclav 625mg Amoxicillin + Clavulanic Acid (Strip of 6 Film-Coated Tablets)
fields.short_description: Broad-spectrum beta-lactamase inhibitor antibacterial for respiratory and skin infections.
fields.description: Moxaclav 625mg combines Amoxicillin 500mg and Clavulanic Acid 125mg. Protects against beta-lactamase degrading enzymes in resistant bacterial strains causing bronchitis, sinusitis, otitis media, and cellulitis.

fields.name: Monas 10mg Montelukast Sodium Tablets (Strip of 10)
fields.short_description: Leukotriene receptor antagonist for asthma management and chronic seasonal allergic rhinitis.
fields.description: Monas 10mg prevents airway edema, smooth muscle contraction, and cellular inflammation in chronic bronchial asthma and exercise-induced bronchoconstriction. Taken once daily in the evening.

fields.name: Alatrex 10mg Cetirizine Dihydrochloride (Strip of 10 Tablets)
fields.short_description: Fast-acting anti-allergy medication for hay fever, allergic conjunctivitis, and skin rashes.
fields.description: Alatrex 10mg blocks histamine receptors to control perennial rhinitis, dust mite allergy, urticaria, and pollen allergies with rapid 20-minute therapeutic onset.

fields.name: Ace Plus Paracetamol 500mg + Caffeine 65mg (Strip of 10 Tablets)
fields.short_description: High-potency dual analgesic for persistent fever, joint pain, and neuralgic headaches.
fields.description: Square Pharma Ace Plus leverages the synergistic action of Caffeine to accelerate Paracetamol absorption by up to 40%, delivering faster onset of analgesia for acute headache and fever episodes.

fields.name: Calbo-D Calcium 500mg + Vitamin D3 200 IU (Bottle of 30 Tablets)
fields.short_description: Essential bone and teeth strengthening formula for osteoporosis prevention.
fields.description: Calbo-D combines Elemental Calcium 500mg (from Calcium Carbonate USP) with Cholecalciferol (Vitamin D3) to ensure optimal intestinal calcium absorption. Clinically proven for bone density maintenance.

fields.name: Filwel Silver Senior 50+ Complete Multivitamin & Mineral (Bottle of 30)
fields.short_description: Specially formulated senior multivitamin supporting heart, brain, eye, and bone density.
fields.description: Filwel Silver provides tailored micronutrient concentrations for adults aged 50 and older. Enriched with Vitamin D3, B-complex, Calcium, and antioxidants to support cognitive function and immunity.

fields.name: Bextram Gold Complete Multivitamin & Multimineral (Bottle of 30 Tablets)
fields.short_description: Comprehensive 32-nutrient daily health supplement with Ginseng, Lutein, and Lycopene.
fields.description: Bextram Gold supports mental stamina, cardiovascular health, visual acuity, and general vitality with Vitamin A through Zinc. Ideal for combating fatigue, nutritional deficiency, and everyday stress.

fields.name: Maxpro 20mg Esomeprazole MUPS Tablets (Strip of 14)
fields.short_description: Multiple Unit Pellet System (MUPS) Esomeprazole for rapid, uniform acid neutralization.
fields.description: Maxpro 20mg MUPS formulation disperses uniformly in the stomach to prevent localized mucosal irritation while delivering rapid systemic bioavailability for acid reflux and peptic ulcer relief.

fields.name: Savlon Antiseptic Soothing Healing Cream 60g Tube
fields.short_description: Soothing antiseptic barrier cream for cuts, scratches, minor burns, and insect stings.
fields.description: Savlon Antiseptic Cream features Chlorhexidine Gluconate and Cetrimide in a non-greasy emollient base. Prevents secondary bacterial infection while soothing irritated epidermal tissues.

fields.name: 3M Micropore Hypoallergenic Surgical Paper Tape (1 inch x 10 yds)
fields.short_description: Gentle, breathable paper tape for securing dressings and wound pads on sensitive skin.
fields.description: Latex-free and hypoallergenic surgical paper tape that adheres gently yet securely to skin and tubing. Allows moisture evaporation and breathability without causing skin tears or painful residue during dressing changes.

fields.name: Waterproof Digital Clinical Oral & Axillary Thermometer
fields.short_description: Fast 60-second digital thermometer with beeper alert and last-reading memory.
fields.description: Omron MC-246 clinical digital thermometer provides highly accurate temperature readings for oral, rectal, or underarm use. Water-resistant casing for easy alcohol sanitization, fever alarm, and auto-shutoff.

fields.name: Comprehensive Emergency Home & Workplace First Aid Kit Box
fields.short_description: Heavy-duty wall-mountable medical first aid kit with 35 essential trauma & emergency items.
fields.description: Equipped with sterile cotton gauze rolls, crepe bandages, triangular slings, surgical tape, curved scissors, stainless tweezers, burn dressing, antiseptic swabs, CPR mask, and safety pins. Complies with workplace safety regulations.

fields.name: Nestle Nescafe Gold Premium Roasted Instant Coffee 200g Glass Jar
fields.short_description: Expertly crafted blend of mountain-grown Arabica and Robusta coffee beans.
fields.description: Golden-roasted to reveal sophisticated aroma and smooth velvety crema. Premium freeze-dried crystals preserve the rich taste of fresh barista brew.

fields.name: Dettol Antiseptic Disinfectant Liquid 500ml
fields.short_description: Iconic brown antiseptic liquid protecting against 100 illness-causing germs.
fields.description: Dettol Antiseptic Liquid with Chloroxylenol (C8H9ClO) delivers proven antibacterial protection for first aid, cuts, grazes, insect bites, and household hygiene. Clinically verified germicidal efficacy trusted worldwide for generations.

fields.name: Khaas Food Wood-Pressed Pure Ghani Mustard Oil 1 Liter Glass Bottle
fields.short_description: Cold-pressed in traditional wooden ghani without chemical solvents or heat processing.
fields.description: Extracted from Grade-1 desi Maghi mustard seeds. Retains natural allyl isothiocyanate pungent aroma, dark golden hue, and heart-healthy Omega-3 and Omega-6 fatty acids.

fields.name: Apex Venturini Handcrafted Italian Full-Grain Leather Oxford Shoes
fields.short_description: Executive closed-lacing dress shoes with Goodyear welted leather sole.
fields.description: Handcrafted from imported full-grain crust leather. Burnished toe cap, cushioned memory foam insole, and durable non-slip stacked heel for effortless boardroom presence.

fields.name: The Ordinary Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% High-Strength Blemish Formula 30ml
fields.short_description: Water-based vitamin and mineral blemish serum targeting excess sebum and enlarged pores.
fields.description: Niacinamide (Vitamin B3) reduces skin blemishes and congestion, supported by Zinc PCA to balance visible sebum activity. Clinically proven to refine skin texture and strengthen the lipid barrier.

fields.name: ASUS TUF Gaming GeForce RTX 4070 Ti SUPER 16GB GDDR6X OC Graphics Card
fields.short_description: Military-grade endurance, dual ball bearing axial fans, and Ada Lovelace DLSS 3 architecture.
fields.description: Engineered with massive heatsink fins and vented aluminum exoskeleton. 16GB GDDR6X memory on 256-bit bus, delivering supreme 1440p and 4K ray tracing performance.

fields.name: Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra 5G AI 12GB/512GB Titanium Gray with S Pen
fields.short_description: Galaxy AI flagship with flat 6.8" 120Hz Dynamic AMOLED 2X, embedded S Pen, and 200MP camera.
fields.description: Features Circle to Search, Live Call Translate, and Note Assist. Titanium frame, Corning Gorilla Armor glass with reduced reflections, and Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 for Galaxy.

fields.name: Apple iPhone 15 Pro Max 256GB Natural Titanium (A17 Pro)
fields.short_description: Aerospace-grade titanium design with A17 Pro chip, Action Button, and 5x optical telephoto.
fields.description: 48MP main camera with 5x telephoto optical zoom, Dynamic Island, Always-On Super Retina XDR display, and USB-C connectivity with 10Gbps transfer speeds.

fields.name: Dell XPS 15 9530 3.5K OLED InfinityEdge Touchscreen Laptop (Core i9 / 32GB)
fields.short_description: Premium CNC aluminum and carbon fiber chassis with 15.6" 3.5K OLED touch display.
fields.description: Intel Core i9-13900H processor, 32GB DDR5 memory, 1TB NVMe SSD, and NVIDIA RTX 4070 studio graphics. Diamond-cut sidewalls, massive glass trackpad, and Waves Nx 3D audio.

fields.name: ASUS ROG Zephyrus G16 OLED Gaming Laptop (Intel Core Ultra 9 / RTX 4080)
fields.short_description: Ultra-thin AI gaming powerhouse with 2.5K OLED 240Hz Nebula Display and Slash Lighting lid.
fields.description: Precision CNC aluminum chassis packs an Intel Core Ultra 9 with dedicated NPU AI acceleration and NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4080 laptop graphics with ROG Intelligent Cooling vapor chamber.

fields.short_description: Supercharged by Apple M3 Max with 16-core CPU, 40-core GPU, and up to 22 hours battery life.
fields.description: Engineered for extreme pro workflows: 3D rendering, machine learning modeling, and 8K ProRes video editing. Liquid Retina XDR display with 1600 nits peak brightness, 3 Thunderbolt 4 ports, and Spatial Audio.
